## Welcome to my page!

I am a full-time MPH student at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public 
Health, concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. My current research
interests are preventive cardiology and pulmonary health. Specifically, 
I am interested  in how social determinants of health, emerging biomarkers, 
and behavioral risk factors influence cardiovascular outcomes. For pulmonary, 
I am interested in how environmental exposures affect COPD, asthma, and
lung cancer. Given our changing times, I am also intrigued by how 
emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence or mobile health 
applications, can be leveraged to enhance chronic disease management.
I hope to become a researcher that bridges the gap between individual patient 
care and population-level research that advances equitable health outcomes 
in cardiopulmonary medicine.
